name: Optimizer (M3) agent — 8-case golden set (target-metric + locale spread)
description: Phase 4 skeleton golden set per optimizer.spec.md §7 + the task brief. The optimizer is a Tier-2 meta agent (D23 M3) that proposes prompt rewrites for one Tier-1 agent at a time. Coverage axes: (a) target metric — task_completion / response_match_v2 / grounding_score / hallucinations_v1 / cost_efficiency / activation_lift; (b) confidence band — high (≥ 0.7) / medium (0.6-0.7) / low (< 0.6 ⇒ caller escalates); (c) simulation_recommended boolean — flips to true when expected lift < +0.05 on any target metric OR diff > 30% of original prompt size; (d) D34 locales — 3 EN + 2 KO + 2 JA + 1 ZH for the `reasoning` field language. Full 30-case set lands in tests/golden/optimizer/*.json during Phase 5 per MATRIX.md §10. The offline_eval_lift threshold per the task brief is ≥ +0.02 on the named target metric — every healthy case in this set satisfies it.

metadata.note: Two clear failure clusters (re-asking + unsolicited budget). The optimizer proposes one diff entry per cluster and projects +0.06 / +0.04 lift on the two target metrics. Confidence ≥ 0.7 so simulation_recommended stays false.

parts.text: {"targetAgentId":"intake","currentPrompt":"You are the campaign intake agent for Social Seeding. Assemble a CampaignBrief from a short conversation. Ask one focused question per turn until you can ship a valid brief. Respond in the user's language. Keep questions <= 2 sentences. Do not ask about budget unless the user volunteers it. Do not re-ask creatorCount once answered.","recentEvalResults":[{"runId":"r1","evalCaseId":"intake_en_03_contradiction_confirms","metric":"task_completion","score":0.55,"passed":false,"failureReason":"agent asked the same question twice"},{"runId":"r2","evalCaseId":"intake_en_04_one_shot","metric":"task_completion","score":0.58,"passed":false,"failureReason":"agent asked the same question twice"},{"runId":"r3","evalCaseId":"intake_ko_05_minimal","metric":"response_match_v2","score":0.62,"passed":false,"failureReason":"agent volunteered budget question"},{"runId":"r4","evalCaseId":"intake_ko_06_one_shot","metric":"response_match_v2","score":0.65,"passed":false,"failureReason":"agent volunteered budget question"}],"targetMetrics":["task_completion","response_match_v2"],"locale":"en","observedFailurePatterns":["agent re-asks creatorCount after it was answered","agent volunteers budget questions despite the brief saying not to"]}

{"proposedPromptDiff":{"added":["Never re-ask a field once the user has answered it; the growing message history is your memory."],"removed":[],"rewritten":["Do not ask about budget unless the user volunteers it. => Do not ask about budget unless the user volunteers it, and never volunteer the topic yourself."]},"expectedLiftPerMetric":{"task_completion":0.06,"response_match_v2":0.04},"confidence":0.72,"reasoning":"Two failure clusters surfaced: repeat-asking on already-answered fields, and unsolicited budget questions. The added line addresses the first by making memory of the history explicit; the rewritten line tightens the second by closing the loophole where the agent treats the don't-ask rule as a soft default.","simulationRecommended":false}

metadata.note: Research agent hallucinating citations when grounding off. Optimizer adds an explicit 'cite parametric knowledge only when grounding is OFF' clause.

parts.text: {"targetAgentId":"research","currentPrompt":"You are the research agent for Social Seeding. Return brand overview, top competitors, market position, and recent news for the named brand. When grounding is enabled, attach citations to sources[]. Respond in the user's locale. Be concise and factual.","recentEvalResults":[{"runId":"r1","evalCaseId":"research_en_07_kbeauty_offline","metric":"hallucinations_v1","score":0.18,"passed":false,"failureReason":"invented funding round citation when grounding was off"},{"runId":"r2","evalCaseId":"research_en_08_kbeauty_offline","metric":"hallucinations_v1","score":0.22,"passed":false,"failureReason":"invented founder name with grounding off"},{"runId":"r3","evalCaseId":"research_en_09_kbeauty_grounded","metric":"grounding_score","score":0.78,"passed":false,"failureReason":"citation 3 unreachable URL"}],"targetMetrics":["hallucinations_v1","grounding_score"],"locale":"en","observedFailurePatterns":["agent fabricates funding round details when grounding is off","agent claims source URLs that 404"]}

{"proposedPromptDiff":{"added":["When grounding is OFF, recent_news must be an empty array. Do NOT invent dates, funding rounds, or founder names. Cite ONLY what your parametric knowledge supports verbatim.","When grounding is ON, every recent_news entry MUST point to a sources[] index. Never cite a URL you did not see in the tool response."],"removed":[],"rewritten":[]},"expectedLiftPerMetric":{"hallucinations_v1":-0.12,"grounding_score":0.08},"confidence":0.78,"reasoning":"Hallucination cluster is driven by the agent treating grounding-off as a license to imagine specifics. Two added clauses make the OFF and ON contracts explicit. Note: hallucinations_v1 expected DELTA is negative because lower is better on this metric — the magnitude (-0.12) matches the observed +0.20 score band of failed runs.","simulationRecommended":false}

metadata.note: Lift is small (+0.03 on response_match_v2) — by the brief's rule, simulation_recommended flips true when any target-metric lift is < +0.05. The optimizer's reasoning explicitly cites this rule.

metadata.note: Conversation classifier mis-routing 'partial_yes' as 'maybe'. Optimizer adds a category disambiguator with concrete examples. JA locale for `reasoning`.

parts.text: {"targetAgentId":"conversation","currentPrompt":"You are the conversation classifier for Social Seeding. Classify each creator reply into one of 8 categories: yes, no, maybe, partial_yes, question, unsubscribe, off_topic, escalate. Return {category, confidence}. Be precise.","recentEvalResults":[{"runId":"r1","evalCaseId":"conv_ja_11_partial_yes","metric":"activation_lift","score":0.48,"passed":false,"failureReason":"partial_yes mis-labeled as maybe"},{"runId":"r2","evalCaseId":"conv_ja_12_partial_yes","metric":"activation_lift","score":0.51,"passed":false,"failureReason":"partial_yes mis-labeled as maybe"},{"runId":"r3","evalCaseId":"conv_ja_13_partial_yes","metric":"activation_lift","score":0.55,"passed":false,"failureReason":"partial_yes mis-labeled as maybe"}],"targetMetrics":["activation_lift"],"locale":"ja","observedFailurePatterns":["クリエイターが条件付きYESを表明したのに『maybe』として分類"]}

'うーん、考えてみます' => maybe."],"removed":[],"rewritten":[]},"expectedLiftPerMetric":{"activation_lift":0.08},"confidence":0.76,"reasoning":"3件のJP failures がすべて conditional-yes を maybe として誤分類しています。日本語の条件付き同意（『〜なら』『〜であれば』）が現行プロンプトでは partial_yes ではなく maybe にマッピングされていました。明示的な例を含む disambiguator を追加してパターン認識を補強します。","simulationRecommended":false}

metadata.note: Content-verify agent escalating too aggressively on uncertain matches. Optimizer raises the threshold + adds a 'soft-uncertainty' bucket so task_completion lifts.

parts.text: {"targetAgentId":"content-verify","currentPrompt":"You are the content-verify agent for Social Seeding. Given a TikTok post, decide whether the brand was meaningfully mentioned.
